query.statement: SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, PLANT_ID, CURRENT_STATE_ID, STATE_CHANGED_AT, STATE_VERSION FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_STATE WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID

SELECT HIST_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, FROM_STATE, TO_STATE, SET_STATE, CHANGED_AT, CHANGED_BY, REASON, SOURCE_TYPE FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_STATE_HISTORY WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY CHANGED_AT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT ALARM_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ALARM_CODE, ALARM_NAME, ALARM_LEVEL, OCCURRED_AT, CLEARED_AT, ELAPSED_SECONDS FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_ALARM WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@alarmLevel IS NULL OR ALARM_LEVEL = @alarmLevel) ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, COUNT(*) AS ALARM_COUNT, MAX(OCCURRED_AT) AS LAST_OCCURRED_AT FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_ALARM GROUP BY EQUIPMENT_ID ORDER BY ALARM_COUNT DESC, LAST_OCCURRED_AT DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT OEE_DATE, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, SHIFT_ID, PLANNED_MINUTES, OPERATING_MINUTES, DOWNTIME_MINUTES, TOTAL_COUNT, GOOD_COUNT, DEFECT_COUNT, AVAILABILITY, PERFORMANCE, QUALITY, OEE FROM EST_OEE_SUMMARY WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY OEE_DATE DESC, EQUIPMENT_ID LIMIT 500

SELECT LOSS_CATEGORY, COUNT(*) AS LOSS_COUNT, SUM(LOSS_MINUTES) AS TOTAL_MINUTES FROM EST_OEE_LOSS WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) GROUP BY LOSS_CATEGORY ORDER BY TOTAL_MINUTES DESC
SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, SUM(LOSS_MINUTES) AS TOTAL_MINUTES, COUNT(*) AS LOSS_COUNT FROM EST_OEE_LOSS GROUP BY EQUIPMENT_ID ORDER BY TOTAL_MINUTES DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT INDEX_ID, INDEX_NAME, INDEX_CATEGORY, UNIT, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_EPT_INDEX WHERE (@isActive IS NULL OR IS_ACTIVE = @isActive) ORDER BY INDEX_NAME

SELECT VALUE_ID, INDEX_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLANT_ID, OEE_DATE, SHIFT_ID, INDEX_VALUE FROM EST_EPT_INDEX_VALUE WHERE (@indexId IS NULL OR INDEX_ID = @indexId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY OEE_DATE DESC, INDEX_ID LIMIT 500

SELECT LAYOUT_ID, PLANT_ID, LAYOUT_NAME, AREA_ID, WIDTH, HEIGHT, IMAGE_URL, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_EPT_LAYOUT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@areaId IS NULL OR AREA_ID = @areaId) ORDER BY LAYOUT_NAME

SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, PLANT_ID, DESCRIPTION, CYCLE_TIME, DO_ALARM_INTERLOCK, DO_MCC, DO_SUMMARY, DO_TACT_TIME, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_EPT_EQUIPMENT_PROPERTY WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID

SELECT PLANT_ID, FROM_STATE_ID, TO_STATE_ID, ALLOW_FLAG, SET_STATE_ID, REQUIRE_REASON, VALID_STATE FROM EST_STATE_MATRIX WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY PLANT_ID, FROM_STATE_ID, TO_STATE_ID

SELECT EVENT_ID, PLANT_ID, EVENT_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_EVENT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EVENT_NAME

SELECT MAP_ID, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ALARM_DEF_ID, SET_STATE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_STATE_ALARM_MAP WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID, ALARM_DEF_ID

SELECT MAP_ID, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID, SET_STATE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM EST_STATE_EVENT_MAP WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID

INSERT INTO EST_EPT_INDEX (INDEX_ID, INDEX_NAME, INDEX_CATEGORY, UNIT, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@indexId, @indexName, @indexCategory, @unit, @description, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)

INSERT INTO EST_EQUIPMENT_EVENT (EVENT_ID, PLANT_ID, EVENT_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@eventId, @plantId, @eventName, @equipmentId, @eventType, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)

INSERT INTO EST_STATE_ALARM_MAP (MAP_ID, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, ALARM_DEF_ID, SET_STATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@mapId, @plantId, @equipmentId, @alarmDefId, @setState, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)

INSERT INTO EST_STATE_EVENT_MAP (MAP_ID, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, EVENT_ID, SET_STATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@mapId, @plantId, @equipmentId, @eventId, @setState, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)
